cap_story_1.descriere_tema: Animated stories for children about two friendly bears exploring the forest, learning life lessons, the alphabet, and nature secrets through fun dialogues
cap_story_1.personaje_si_lume: Barnaby (a big friendly brown bear with a deep warm voice) and Pip (a curious little bear cub), living in a lush animated forest with talking animals
cap_story_1.paleta_culori: Enchanted Forest & Nature (Lush Green, Warm Wood, Sunlit Gold)
